entries.name: irq0_vector
entries.comment: ADSP-2100 interrupt vectors: IRQn jumps to PM n (adsp2100.cpp:880). All four are RTI: the program runs without interrupts. IRQ0

entries.name: irq1_vector
entries.comment: IRQ1: RTI

entries.name: irq2_vector
entries.comment: IRQ2: RTI

entries.name: irq3_vector
entries.comment: IRQ3: RTI

entries.name: reset
entries.comment: Reset entry: the ADSP-2100 starts at PM 4 (adsp2100.cpp:636; MAME shows PC 4 while the 68k holds the ADSP in reset). CALL 0780 and CALL 0834 initialise, then L0-L7 = 0, M1 = M7 = 1.

entries.name: frame_loop
entries.comment: Top of the frame loop: 00C2 jumps back here after each frame.

entries.name: wait_frame_trigger
entries.comment: Spins while DM 1FFF reads FFFF (0013-0015): the 68k starts a frame by writing DM 1FFF through 80BFFE, which MAME also turns into a CPU sync (hd68k_adsp_data_w, harddriv_m.cpp:591). docs/01 section 5. [idle read of DM 1FFF, the 68k's frame trigger word (MAME's speedup hooks this read: init_stunrun, hdadsp_speedup_r)]
DM 1FFF = FFFF: re-arms the frame trigger

entries.name: copy_frame_parameters
entries.comment: Copies DM 1FEF-1FF4 to PM 1019-101E, DM 1FF5-1FFD to PM 1000-1008 and DM 1FE9-1FEE to PM 1009-100E: the 68k's per-frame parameters into the PM workspace at 1000-1028 (HYP: view matrix and position; M3).

entries.name: select_object_page
entries.comment: /MP = DM 1FFE: the object ROM page the 68k chose for this frame.
/MP: object ROM page, base = 0x10000 * value (case 7, harddriv_m.cpp:829)
/SOMCLK: SOM output buffer address (case 3, harddriv_m.cpp:815)
SOMLATCH: a word to the SOM output buffer at the SOM address, which then advances (case 2, harddriv_m.cpp:811)
SOMLATCH: a word to the SOM output buffer at the SOM address, which then advances (case 2, harddriv_m.cpp:811)

entries.name: next_object
entries.comment: Per-object loop: counts objects in DM 0030; 0097 and 00B3 jump back here.
/GINT: interrupt the 68k at level 2 (case 6, harddriv_m.cpp:823)

entries.name: read_object_list
entries.comment: Reads the next entry of the object list the 68k wrote in data RAM (pointer in DM 001B); FFFF ends the frame (0053 -> 00B4). The low 12 bits are kept in DM 001C/0009.

entries.name: read_object_pointer
entries.comment: Fetches the object's ROM address: /SIMCLK = the entry, /MP = 0, two NOPs, /SIMBUF read, then the word shifted left by 2 is split into a page (SR1 -> /MP) and an address (SR0 -> /SIMCLK). HYP: a word pointer in units of 4 words; M3 decodes it. [/SIMCLK: object ROM word address (hdadsp_special_w case 1, harddriv_m.cpp:807)]
/MP: object ROM page, base = 0x10000 * value (case 7, harddriv_m.cpp:829)
/SIMBUF read: the object ROM word at the /MP page + the /SIMCLK address, which then advances (hdadsp_special_r case 0, harddriv_m.cpp:780)
/MP: object ROM page, base = 0x10000 * value (case 7, harddriv_m.cpp:829)
/SIMCLK: object ROM word address (hdadsp_special_w case 1, harddriv_m.cpp:807)
per object: CALL 00F6, 0114, 0174 (M3)

entries.name: end_frame
entries.comment: End of frame: SOMLATCH FFFF, CALL 080B, /SOMCLK 0, two SOM header words, /GINT (00C1) to tell the 68k, JUMP 0006.
SOMLATCH: a word to the SOM output buffer at the SOM address, which then advances (case 2, harddriv_m.cpp:811)
/SOMCLK: SOM output buffer address (case 3, harddriv_m.cpp:815)

entries.name: read_object_header
entries.comment: Reads three words through /SIMBUF into I0 (011C, 011F, 0123), the second and third kept in DM 0032 and DM 08DA as loop counts for the copies that follow (HYP; M3).
/SIMBUF read: the object ROM word at the /MP page + the /SIMCLK address, which then advances (hdadsp_special_r case 0, harddriv_m.cpp:780)

entries.name: read_object_record
entries.comment: Object record reader: /SIMCLK = DM 0034 (017B), two /SIMBUF reads (017F into AX1, 0182 into SI), then JUMP (I4) at 0186 through the table at 0187 indexed by the top 4 bits of the second word. M3 decodes the record types.

entries.name: init_0780
entries.comment: Called from reset (0004) and at the start of every frame (003D): sets M and L registers and constants (HYP; M3).

entries.name: finish_frame_080B
entries.comment: Called at the end of each frame (00B9), before the SOM header is written (HYP: emits the sorted polygon list; M3).

entries.name: init_0834
entries.comment: Called after 0780 (0005, 003E): fills data RAM from 0959 with FFFF/7FFF (HYP: clears the SOM sort buckets; M3).

entries.name: pm_tables
entries.comment: PM 1029-1235, loaded by the last two records: disassembles as noise, read as data (HYP: tables). PM 1000-1028 is the workspace that 0018 fills.
